I took my dog ​​to this shop for a bath for the second time and, once again, the service was impeccable! The young man who attended to me is extremely polite, and the lady at reception always greets me with great kindness. My dog ​​always comes out smelling wonderful and happy. I highly recommend it!

I went to buy a cat screen and mentioned that I had another one to return, but I lost the receipt. I told the lady I preferred to buy it and then my partner would return it. The blessed woman calls me saying it was bought at the Corujeira store and that I had to deal with it there! I said okay, my partner will return it later, but I wanted to know if they have a network to buy it from, and she repeated that it's only available at the Corujeira store. I don't understand these customer service interactions where the person doesn't want to sell. In short, I'm not going to waste the trip again, I'll buy it online because customer service is so negligent!

I left my 8-month-old dog to be bathed and groomed. He came back with one eye completely red, a huge hemorrhage, a dislocated joint in one paw, and burns in some areas of his abdomen. I went back to the shop to find out what had happened, and the dog didn't want to go in; he trembled the whole time. He'd never reacted like this anywhere else, or with anyone. I confirmed several things with the shop owner, but the dog's reaction made the situation even clearer. There are injuries that a dog will never get over 😥 I strongly advise against it!
